t: Transgender Day of Remembrance – GSA Network
s: The Transgender Day of Remembrance (TDOR) is observed annually on November 20th to memorialize those who were murdered due to anti-transgender hatred or prejudice. Although not every person represented during the Day of Remembrance self-identified as transgender, each was a victim of violence based on bias against transgender people.

t: Transgender Day of Remembrance | Duke University Medical Center Library Online
